01: About

Facilitator, first.
Strategist, always.

I'm a growth strategist and facilitator with over four years scaling blockchain and fintech products across payments, Layer2, DeFi, and blockchain gaming. I work with product, leadership, and community teams so go-to-market plans match what is actually launching and what users are saying.

My work sits at the intersection of marketing, partnerships, and community: campaigns that drive adoption, partnerships that expand ecosystems, and communities that carry product feedback, retention, and growth. I have also run paid acquisition across 60 countries and regions, benchmarking what customers cost in each market.

Well travelled, with exposure and connections built across continents; that, paired with a high industry reputation, makes every marketing execution smoother and cheaper to run.

04: Field Notes

What the dashboards taught me

Paid Acquisition

Benchmarking CAC across countries and regions
Question

Where do budgets perform best, and how does audience behaviour differ by region?

Platforms

Paid acquisition on Meta (Facebook, Instagram, Threads, WhatsApp), LinkedIn, Google Ads, X, and TikTok.

Outcome

Benchmark CAC data across Africa, Europe, Asia, and the Americas, with better budget allocation, sharper audience segmentation, and a clearer view of which platforms work in which market.

Hurdles

Ad permission and policy restrictions in markets such as Ghana, South Africa, and Iceland, and the time needed to validate results at this scale.

Google Ads, 3 days: 27.4K impressions, 1.36K clicks, $0.09 avg CPC X Ads, one day: 725K impressions, 3,414 link clicks
Read the post ↗

Performance Marketing

A 1% CTR isn't the finish line
Question

Can a high-CTR ad convert, scale, and hold its efficiency as spend increases?

What the data showed

In one X Ads campaign, the highest-CTR ad (1.87%) drove 359 link clicks, while the top ad by volume ran at 0.45% CTR and drove 1,297. The 25–34 age group delivered the most impressions (248,170) and 1,114 link clicks.

Takeaway

Judge ads on whether they convert, scale, and stay efficient as spend grows, not on CTR alone.
